title: Content Creation & Storytelling Workshop in Hampi
tagline: A 3-day practical, experiential workshop in the heart of Hampi with Akash Mahale & Siddhi Dalvi. Strictly limited to 10 creators.

creator.name: Akash Mahale
creator.intro: I give Hampi a huge amount of credit for shaping the artist in me. Because this place has changed me in so many ways. The person I am today is probably not who I was four years ago. Hampi didn't just teach me how to travel — it helped me discover the artist within me. Everything I've learned, experienced, and understood over the last 4 years is something I now want to share with all of you.
creator.voiceSection: I've kept only 10 seats for this workshop because I don't just want to teach — I want to spend time with each person, understand their creative journey, and give them the best possible learning experience with individual attention.
creator.quoteMarathi: हा Workshop फक्त टेक्निकल गोष्टी किंवा पुस्तकात शिकवलं जातं तसं शिकवण्यापुरता मर्यादित नाही. कारण मी स्वतःही या सगळ्या गोष्टी पुस्तकातून नाही, तर प्रत्यक्ष अनुभवातून, माणसांकडून आणि प्रवासातून शिकलोय. म्हणून इथेही माझा जास्तीत जास्त भर Practical Learning वर असेल.

workshop.joinDetails: Detailed boarding instructions, packing guide, and stay details will be shared on WhatsApp and email after payment verification.

sections.title: Breakfast & Gamified Welcome
sections.subtitle: Check-in @ Hampi Nature Cottage (Hippie Island 🛖🌴)
items: Welcome and introduction of participants in a Bali-themed property surrounded by Hampi hills
Introduction to Akash and the creative team
Warm, authentic South Indian breakfast

sections.title: Session 1: Storytelling Fundamentals with Akash
items: Write meaningful short-form scripts that connect emotionally
Create hooks nobody wants to skip in the first 3 seconds
Break down Akash's real viral scripts and videos line-by-line
Learn to craft endings that leave a deep, lasting impact

sections.title: Lunch Break
sections.subtitle: Delicious traditional South Indian vegetarian food 🍛
items: Hot South Indian vegetarian feast with authentic local flavors

sections.title: Session 2: Visual Learning & Cinematography — Special Lecture by Siddhi Dalvi
sections.subtitle: Actor | Model | Assistant Director | DOP Assistant
items: Learn how to tell stories and bring raw emotions to life through visuals
Understand the aesthetic, framing, and mood behind every frame
Explore camera angles, composition, shot sizes, and the storytelling meaning behind them
Learn how to shoot effective B-rolls and why they make or break your video

sections.title: 📽️ Practical Activity: Outdoor Shooting Exercise
sections.subtitle: Picturesque fields and ancient boulder ruins of Hampi
items: Live hands-on shooting exercise applying what you just learned
Surrounded by the timeless history of Hampi's boulders and heritage rocks
Direct 1-on-1 field coaching from Akash and Siddhi

sections.title: ☕️ Tea Break & Session 3: Introduction to Basic Editing with Akash
items: Evening tea break with snacks
Core editing structure, footage sorting, timeline assembly, and narrative pacing

sections.title: Dinner & Night Activity: Screening & Constructive Review
sections.subtitle: Delicious South Indian dinner followed by group screening 🛖
items: Edit the day's footage with guidance
Group screening of participants' work on projector
Personalized review and creative feedback by Akash and the team

sections.title: Morning: Move to Second Stay Near Virupaksha Temple 🛕
sections.subtitle: Check-in @ Rocky Guest House, Hampi
items: Travel across town to our second stay near the historic Virupaksha Temple
Immerse in ancient architecture, local culture, and dynamic street life
Breakfast at a picturesque cafe surrounded by panoramic Hampi views

sections.title: Session 1: Storytelling & Scriptwriting with Akash
items: Voiceover Mastery: Make your voice sound natural, warm, and engaging
Learn voice modulation, pauses, breathing, and emotional delivery
Turn real-life spontaneous travel moments into stories worth telling
How to structure, build suspense, and keep the audience hooked till the last second

sections.title: Lunch Break & Session 2: Advanced Editing Workshop with Akash
items: Delicious South Indian lunch break
Watch Akash break down his exact video editing workflow from raw clips to final export
Master how visuals, sound design, music, stickers, typography, and pacing work together
Get an exclusive look at Akash's actual editing timelines
Watch Akash write, shoot, and edit a complete video live in real-time

sections.title: Practical Activity: Outdoor Storytelling & Shooting
sections.subtitle: Heritage monuments and vibrant alleys near Virupaksha Temple
items: Shoot your main workshop project in a completely different aesthetic setting
Capture authentic human stories and architectural grandeur

sections.title: Tea Break & Group Activity: Evening Creative Exchange
sections.subtitle: Delicious South Indian dinner & community bonding
items: Collaborative evening session, idea exchange, and creator community networking
Milestone: You leave the workshop with 1 fully curated, shot & edited video created by you!

sections.title: Return Bus Journey (Hampi → Pune & Mumbai)
sections.subtitle: For Travel Package holders 🚌
items: Morning farewell and group photos
Comfortable AC bus transportation from Hampi back to Pune & Mumbai
Lifetime access to the creator cohort network

privacy.refundPolicy: All workshop fees are non-refundable. Because slots are strictly limited to 10 participants, cancellations cannot be refunded.
